_comment: Tool/function definitions for Maya's Sarvam app (Amrita---We-4517816a-a47a). Register these in the Sarvam dashboard's tool/function-calling editor for the OUTBOUND and INBOUND agent versions used on calls. Each tool makes an HTTP call to Tringlo's deterministic backend, which runs the real database operation and returns a structured result. Field names here follow the common JSON-Schema function-calling shape; map them to Sarvam's tool editor fields as needed. Do NOT paste the token into source control — read it from the hospital workspace's webhook token.

endpoint.auth_alternative: If Sarvam's tool config cannot send a header, append ?k={WELLNESS_WEBHOOK_TOKEN} to the url instead (less preferred — keeps the token out of logs only with the header).

response_envelope.ok: boolean — true if the operation succeeded
response_envelope.data: object — present when ok:true; speak from this
response_envelope.error: string — present when ok:false; explain this to the caller
response_envelope.code: string — machine-readable failure code when ok:false
response_envelope.correlationId: string — ties the call to Tringlo's logs

endpoint.notes: A failed tool still returns HTTP 200 with ok:false — read `ok`, never the HTTP status. Typical response time is single-digit milliseconds; wait for the result before speaking.

tools.name: get_doctors
tools.description: List the hospital's doctors and their specialties. Use when the caller asks who is available or wants to choose a doctor.

tools.name: search_doctors
tools.description: Find doctors by name, specialty or department. Use when the caller names a specialty (e.g. 'a cardiologist') or a doctor.

tools.name: check_doctor_availability
tools.description: Check a doctor's genuinely free appointment slots on a specific date. Always call this before offering any time; never invent availability.

tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: Get available slots for a doctor (or specialty) across a range of upcoming days. Use when the caller is flexible on the date.

days.description: How many days ahead to scan (1-14)

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment in a verified free slot. Only call after reading the details back and getting the caller's explicit confirmation. Returns the real appointment reference id on success.

tools.name: get_patient_appointments
tools.description: Retrieve a caller's existing appointments by their phone number.

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move an existing appointment to a new, genuinely free slot. Confirm the new time with the caller first. Preserves the original in history.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel an appointment. Only call with confirm:true after the caller has explicitly agreed to cancel.

confirm.description: Must be true; set only after explicit caller confirmation

tools.name: get_appointment_details
tools.description: Retrieve one appointment's details. Pass the caller's phone to verify ownership before reading anything out.
